title: Ukubhuda Emoyeni
intro: Khawucinge ngommandla apho okungabonakaliyo nokubonwayo kudibana khona, uze ume phambi komntu osentliziyweni yobukumkani obungafaniyo nomnye umntu. Lo mphefumlo unolwazi olungaphaya kokufikelela, amandla alawulayo abanye abanokuyicinga. Sekunjalo, kwanamandla amakhulu anokuthotywa sisidalwa esincinci, kwaye inyaniso ingahlala ifihliwe kude kube lixesha elimiselweyo. Ngubani lo mntu onelifa elihlala lihleli?
clues: Ndanikwa ubukumkani obungayi kubakho mntu emva kwam.
Umoya wawuphantsi komyalelo wam, uhamba ngokomyalelo wam naphi na apho ndithanda khona.
Ndandiyiqonda intetho yeentaka, kwaye zazisebenza emkhosini wam.
Ndifumene iindaba ezivela kwintaka encinci malunga nokumkanikazi owayenqula ilanga.
Ukufa kwam kwahlala kufihliwe de kwathi isidalwa somhlaba sadla intonga yam, kwaye kulapho ke kuphela apho iijin zaqonda khona ukuba azizazi izinto ezingabonakaliyo.

outcome.answer: Ukufa kwakhe kwafihlwa kwiinjin de kwatyiwa intonga yakhe

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
